title.en: The Four Qi Adjust the Spirit

summary: Explains how to maintain health by adapting to the four seasons and their corresponding qi patterns.

sections.title: Spring Season Adaptation
sections.originalText: 春三月，此谓发陈。天地俱生，万物以荣。夜卧早起，广步于庭，被发缓形，以使志生。生而勿杀，予而勿夺，赏而勿罚。此春气之应，养生之道也。
sections.translation: The three months of spring are called "development and renewal". Heaven and earth give birth together, all things flourish. Sleep late at night and rise early, walk widely in the courtyard, loosen the hair and relax the body, to enable the will to grow. Give life but do not kill, give but do not take away, reward but do not punish. This is responding to spring qi, the way of nourishing life.
sections.interpretation: This section describes the principle of adapting to spring energy. Spring is a time of growth and expansion, so humans should align with this upward, outward energy.
